comment: Experimental ALIGN Sky130 to official/open_pdks Sky130 compatibility metadata. This file is read-only guidance for wrappers and diagnostics; it is not consumed by ALIGN generation unless a script opts into it.

M1.note: ALIGN abstract M1 is Sky130 local interconnect.

special_layers.Fin: ALIGN template/grid artifact with no Sky130 planar drawing-layer equivalent.
special_layers.Pc: ALIGN poly-contact generator config; mos.py emits this wire on Poly.
special_layers.Rvt: VT helper/id layer; no direct base drawing-layer match in current SkyWater docs.
special_layers.Slvt: VT helper/id layer; no direct base drawing-layer match in current SkyWater docs.
special_layers.Hvt: VT helper/id layer with nonstandard current GDS value; requires generated GDS and Magic evidence.
special_layers.CapMIMContact: MIM helper/contact layer; validate against generated capacitor topology.
special_layers.GuardRing: Generator config, not a streamed GDS layer entry.
special_layers.Cap: Generator config, not a streamed GDS layer entry.

notes: Do not use this file as evidence that DRC/LVS passes. It only records the current best static mapping.
Via cut widths in layers.json should not be changed from enclosure-footprint arithmetic without Magic DRC evidence.
Apply netlist normalization equally to unconstrained ALIGN and AnalogDSL-constrained outputs for fair comparison.
